entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: The red-aligned knightly court of the Realm on Eldraine, centered on a free city and a tournament complex called the Burning Yard.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane on which the Realm and its five knightly courts lie.

entities.name: Irencrag
entities.description: A massive boulder glowing with volcanic heat beside the Burning Yard that tests aspiring knights of Embereth and can bestow legendary names on swords.

entities.name: Embercleave
entities.description: A legendary magical sword given its name by the Irencrag.

entities.name: Elven Lords
entities.description: Rulers who once enslaved mankind before being overthrown.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault during which Embereth came under heavy attack.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invading horde that attacked Embereth.

events.summary: Mankind overthrows the Elven Lords who had enslaved them, and the five knightly courts are created, with Embereth established around the Irencrag.
events.quote: The court of Embereth was established around the Irencrag.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Embereth is heavily attacked; its knights fight the Phyrexian horde for three days and all but a few fall defending the court.
events.quote: The knights of the court fought valiantly for three days against the Phyrexian horde, with all but a few falling in the court's defense.

relations.note: Embereth's knights fought the Phyrexian horde.
relations.quote: The knights of the court fought valiantly for three days against the Phyrexian horde, with all but a few falling in the court's defense.

relations.note: Court of the Realm on Eldraine.
relations.quote: Embereth was the red -aligned court of the Realm on the plane of Eldraine .
